summary:
Okafor CRC 2026 worklist (RBC-QM-02), 4 members, all in the population (aged 46-75 at end of 2026).

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0003), patient messaged (comm-t0005) | No qualifying screening on record. First judged excluded (age 66+, frailty plus donepezil). Dr. Lin's message (comm-00301) then said the Frailty diagnosis (cond-00189) was put on her chart in error, and it is now marked entered in error. Without frailty, the frailty/advanced-illness exclusion fails. No other exclusion: lives at home, no nursing home, hospice or colorectal cancer. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice episode eoc-00002 (finished), 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21, for pancreatic cancer. The outside discharge summary (doc-00402) confirms it. Her revoking hospice does not undo the exclusion. No order and no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0001), patient messaged (comm-t0002) | The only FIT (obs-01732) was corrected: it was collected 12/31/2025. 01/05/2026 was the date the lab received it. So it falls outside 2026, and no other qualifying test is on record. No exclusions. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0004), patient messaged (comm-t0006) | First judged up to date on a 2024-06-11 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871). The lab's correction notice (doc-00401) withdrew it as another patient's specimen, and it is now entered in error. Her 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, and an order does not count. No exclusions. |

Other actions:
- All FIT orders run 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. None of the three patients had an active FIT order before.
- Each outreach message says the kit is on its way and explains how to complete and return it.
- Signed progress notes give the reasoning for each patient (doc-t0007 to doc-t0010).
- Four new inbox items arrived after I started (inbox-a0001 to a0004). I reviewed each one, and I closed each one linked to the resulting orders, messages and notes.
- Your other inbox items have nothing to do with this worklist and are still open.
